cards.title: Rating scale and notch calculator (src/ratings/notch.mjs)
cards.context:
REQ-06-02. Create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs. Plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm deps (package.json untouched), pure functions, no I/O, no console.*, no module-level mutable state. Read CLAUDE.md first. node:test + node:assert/strict, TDD. Commit format 'T-xx: <what changed>'. The BA spec in specs/ holds all examples and the test design.
Exports: RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze of the 19 C1 ratings AAA,AA+,AA,AA-,A+,A,A-,BBB+,BBB,BBB-,BB+,BB,BB-,B+,B,B-,CCC+,CCC,CCC- (best first; no CC/C/D/SD/NR). notchChange(previous,current) = idx(current)-idx(previous) (downgrade positive; never -0, no Math.sign/negation). notchCalculator(previous,current) -> exactly {notches, direction:'downgrade'|'upgrade'|'unchanged', wl}; notches===notchChange; wl = n>=3?2 : n===2?1 : 0 (1-notch downgrade, upgrades, unchanged all 0). No shared threshold helper (Indicator 12 in T-02 differs). BBB+->BB+ is 3 notches/WL 2 (the POC text's 2/WL1 is wrong). Input rule: only primitive strings are candidates; x.trim().toUpperCase() then exact RATING_SCALE membership; anything else (null, undefined, numbers, objects, arrays, String objects, '', 'D', 'BBB +') throws RangeError, never TypeError; previous validated before current; message names the argument and the value (rendered safely).
acceptance: AC-1: RATING_SCALE deep-equals the 19 C1 ratings, frozen list → exact
AC-2: isFrozen true; push/index-set/reverse throw TypeError; scale unchanged
AC-3: notchChange = idx(current)-idx(previous), integer, never -0 → examples exact
AC-4: case and trim() whitespace accepted in either position → treated as scale value
AC-5: any non-scale/non-string input as previous or current → RangeError, never TypeError
AC-5: notchChange('X','Y') RangeError message contains 'previous' and 'X'
AC-7: upgrades/unchanged → wl 0, notches signed, no -0
AC-10: all 361 pairs match the formula; antisymmetry; diagonal 0
AC-11: exports typeof ok; no output, no I/O import, no console, package.json unchanged

cards.title: Indicator 12 country rating change WL (src/indicators/countryRating.mjs)
cards.context:
REQ-03-12. Create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. Depends on T-01 (notchChange validates and normalises both arguments). Plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm deps (package.json untouched), pure functions, no I/O, no console.*, no module-level mutable state. Read CLAUDE.md first. node:test + node:assert/strict, TDD. Commit format 'T-xx: <what changed>'. The BA spec in specs/ holds all examples and the test design.
Export countryRatingChangeWl(previous,current) -> primitive 0|1|2: import {notchChange} from '../ratings/notch.mjs'; n=notchChange(previous,current); return n>=2?2 : n===1?1 : 0. No copy of the scale, no own validation, let RangeError propagate, no try/catch; do not edit src/ratings/**. Thresholds differ from the calculator: BBB+->BBB gives 1 here, 0 in the calculator. Never -0.
acceptance: AC-8: countryRatingChangeWl downgrades → 1 for 1 notch, 2 for 2+ (BBB+→BBB = 1)
AC-8: BBB+→BBB gives 1 here and calculator wl 0
AC-4: case and trim() whitespace accepted in either position
AC-5: any invalid input → RangeError from notchChange, never TypeError
AC-5: ('X','Y') message contains 'previous' and 'X', passed through unwrapped
AC-10: imports notchChange from ../ratings/notch.mjs, no scale copy, no own validation
AC-11: export is a function; no output, only import is notch.mjs, diff only in indicators, full suite passes
